rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
compound with internal sandhi joining attainment of powers and the root Kaula teaching

items.question: What elements constitute the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The verse enumerates eight as a distinct element.
The verse includes the attainment of powers.
These elements are identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: The eight and the attainment of powers together constitute the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The specific referent of the eight is not explicitly named in this verse.
The exact syntactic relation within the fused compound is compressed.
items.plain_english: O fair-faced one, the eight and the attainment of powers are the root Kaula.
